items.title: Free Dotted Flower Cluster DXF Panel for Privacy Screens
items.description: Simple six-petal flowers of varying sizes are scattered across the panel alongside a field of small dots and circles, producing a light, confetti-like rhythm. The minimal flower shapes combined with generous negative space make this one of the fastest, most budget-friendly patterns to cut in this batch.

items.description: Tall heart-shaped vines curl upward with layered petal fans and slender leaves, echoing Art Nouveau ironwork. The vertical repeat makes it a natural fit for tall gates, panels, and room dividers.

items.title: Triple Layered Flower Mandala Geometric Lattice Screen
items.description: A beautifully structured decorative panel featuring three large, vertically stacked circular flower mandalas. The blooming floral motifs are set against a rigid, interlocking square and diagonal grid lattice framework that ensures maximum structural strength.
